adjudication.rationale: Diff shows Admin::GroupsController#update was rewritten to update alias_level (when params[:alias_level].present?), visible, and conditionally rename non-automatic groups (group.name = params[:name] if params[:name] && !group.automatic), with an else branch rendering render_json_error(group) on save failure. In the updated spec, the only remaining .update test asserts that an automatic group ignores a name change and updates visible; the prior normal-group update test (rename + membership usernames) was removed. There is no new test exercising non-automatic rename, alias_level persistence, or the save-failure/render_json_error path, so regressions in those new/changed branches would not be caught by this suite.
